plain: Eager to equal or beat another.

webster.text: Desirous or eager to imitate, equal or excel another; desirous of like excellence with another; with of; as emulous of another's example or virtues.

more.text: Rivaling; engaged in competition; as emulous Carthage.

example.quote: who, emulous of eclipsing each other in the glorious assertion of the dignity of human nature, courted every danger, and were ever ready, when necessary, to lay down their lives at the altar of liberty:
